about.subtitle: WHO'S PATRICK?
about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Patrick — physicist, engineer, and developer. I've always wanted to figure out how things work and use that insight to shape new things. As a product quality and process engineer, I learned to understand systems down to the last detail and never leave quality to chance. That's exactly the mindset I put into software today: understanding logic, building something practical — while constantly improving, learning new technologies, and bringing projects to life.
about.paragraph2: Let's work together and create something meaningful that brings value to others!
about.workMode2: Hybrid: within daily commuting range, ideally 3 days on-site / 2 remote (flexible by arrangement). Beyond commuting distance, 1–2 multi-day on-site visits per month with overnight stay — just not on Mondays.

skills.subtitle: MY STACK
skills.title: Skill Set
skills.intro: I started out in development with R/R-Shiny, which is where I found my enthusiasm for web technologies. Python and the web stack (HTML, CSS, JS) followed. I extended production web apps with PHP, which I enjoyed. I've since worked my way into Angular, and I'm always open to picking up new technologies — React, Vue, or whatever comes next.

projects.subtitle: MY CRAFT
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Curious? Take a look at the projects below - every interaction is a design decision, every detail a deliberate choice. Frontend-focused builds, with Supabase when a backend is needed.
projects.rec1Text: I got to know Patrick as a consistent and reliable developer. He finds great solutions even when bugs come up and brings a high level of expertise, especially in the area of databases. His clear communication rounds off a very pleasant collaboration.
projects.rec2Text: Patrick Schauer was a reliable and helpful team member on the 'Join' project. He placed great importance on good team structure and fair task distribution, ensuring everyone could take on suitable responsibilities. Particularly noteworthy are his supportive nature, strong organisational skills, and the pleasant collaboration within the team.

join.description: A Kanban-inspired task manager 📌 that keeps work flowing — drag tasks across columns, assign teammates, and group everything by category so nothing slips through.
join.implementation: Built as a single-page Angular app with Supabase as the backend for auth and data. Tasks are persisted in real time, drag-and-drop is implemented with the Angular CDK, and the UI is fully responsive down to mobile.

epl.description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer 🎮 written in object-oriented JavaScript — guide Pepe through the desert, grab coins and tabasco bottles, and take down the boss hen.
epl.implementation: A side-scrolling platformer rendered on HTML5 Canvas. The architecture is class-based: separate entities for the player, enemies, collectibles, and the world, each with their own update/draw cycle driven by a central game loop.

contact.heading: Looking for reinforcement? Let's talk!
contact.intro: Frontend with Angular and TypeScript, full-stack understanding from R-Shiny to Django — I build interfaces with care and think beyond the UI. I'm looking for a team where I can make a meaningful contribution with precision, curiosity, and a love of learning. Sounds like your project? Drop me a line!

privacyPolicy.collectionHeading: 2. Collection and Processing of Personal Data

privacyPolicy.formBody: When you use the contact form on this website, the data you provide (name, email address, message) will be processed for the purpose of handling your enquiry. This data is used solely to respond to your request and will be deleted afterwards. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to enquiries).
privacyPolicy.hostingBody: This website is hosted by netcup GmbH, Daimlerstraße 25, 76185 Karlsruhe, Germany. When the website is accessed, the hosting provider automatically stores server log files containing your browser type, operating system, referrer URL, IP address and access time. These data are technically necessary and are not merged with other data sources. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

privacyPolicy.rightsBody2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The competent authority is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information Baden-Württemberg (LfDI BW).
